data.description:
Codebase-health audit run 2026-08-05/06. 73 candidate findings were verified by independent
blue-team agents that never saw the discovery agents' output; 27 survived a validity floor of 0.75
and an impact floor of 0.5. Nine were dropped on citation vetoes or outright refutation — including
two fabricated citations produced by the audit's own discovery agents, which is why the
verification pass is load-bearing and not ceremony.

Remediations were proposed by two agents working blind to each other; 16 of 20 moves converged
independently. Four divergent items went to OSS research, which overturned both proposers twice.

Full audit record: `.joe-janitor/report-2026-08-06.md`.
Durable playbook: `.joe-janitor/tools.md`.

Scope note: the bridge/reconciler command-surface redesign that this audit surfaced is tracked as
its own epic, not here. The `doctor`/`fsck`/`validate` consolidation is tracked on existing epic
`dabb-7d4b-f5bc-40e6`; only two cheap decoupled wins from it are carried here.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Code-review provenance is wired: `--ref`/`--source` reach `CodeReviewRequest`, and results
      carry `source`/`verified_at_sha` like the four sibling producers
- [ ] The snapshot-entry contract is enforced by CI rather than asserted by an ADR
- [ ] An `LLM-Review` vote provably attaches to the tree that was reviewed
- [ ] `docs/exit-codes.md` covers every dispatcher arm and every emitted code, and CI keeps it that way
- [ ] `bug_close_reason_ok` and the `_attestation.py` module are deleted
- [ ] ADR numbers uniquely identify a document, and a new collision cannot merge
- [ ] Comment triage complete across all six subsystem shards, with each shard's `do_not_move` list
      preserved as the protection record
- [ ] No library read path can terminate its host process
- [ ] The "passed but unsigned ⇒ retryable" rule is available to CLI and MCP from one implementation
- [ ] One terminal-state predicate decides whether a blocker is satisfied, everywhere
- [ ] Retired config files honour the deprecation registry's `behavior` field
- [ ] `validate --fix` no longer advertises a repair it does not perform
- [ ] `docs/chatgpt-agent-guide.md` no longer directs agents to the wrong command
data.title: Janitor Cleanup 2026-08-06
